content:
anya: FYI onboarding Hermes-7B (int4) hit a surprising summarization quality regression after our quant pass. Short thread with repro and fixes.

anya: baseline fp16 ppl ~12.1, our int4 calibration ppl ~12.7 but abstractive summarization ROUGE fell ~6 pts and outputs were shorter / looped.

mike: can you share conversion + quant config?

anya: conversion notes: preserved original vocab ids, applied NFKC normalization, merged a few unicode variants. quant config: `per_channel=true symmetric=false clip_pct=99.9 calibrate_batches=256`.

sam: Hermes has a nonstandard projection layout: heads are interleaved (h0k0,h1k0,h2k0...) rather than block-contiguous. If loader assumed block order that permutes per-head projection slices and breaks rotary/head alignment.

leslie: yep. If KV/proj ordering is wrong, rotary phases apply to the wrong vector components -> outputs degrade even if ppl looks ok-ish.

anya: quick test: swapped loader to apply interleaved->block permute and re-ran a 100-sample summarization smoke. ppl improved to ~12.3 and ROUGE recovered ~+5 pts. Rotary-scale tweak (0.75->1.0) had minimal effect.

mike: also check tokenizer id collisions from normalization (soft-hyphen, zero-width glue, etc.). Those can corrupt prefix cache and long-context behavior.

anya: tokenmap histogram found 2 duplicate ids after NFKC mapping; fixed mapping dedupe and reran -> small additional quality gain and fewer repeats.

ci-bot: CI triggered: hermes/onboard/triage/1760012345 (calibration + loader-permute + tokenmap-check). ETA ~ 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: proposed action items: 1) merge loader permute fix and add unit test; 2) add tokenmap-dedupe histogram check as a conversion smoke test; 3) add auto-detect heuristic for proj order (checkpoint attr + shape heuristics + quick smoke ppl comparison if ambiguous); 4) run full eval suite before marking onboard done.

mike: I'll add the tokenmap histogram check to the loader and a fuzzy-normalization report in the conversion tool. For proj-order heuristic, check for known shapes (weights shaped [num_heads, head_dim*3] vs [head_dim, num_heads*3]) and metadata `proj_layout`. If still ambiguous, run both variants on a tiny sample and pick lower ppl.

leslie: add a short note in the onboarding checklist: "verify projection ordering & tokenmap dedupe; run summarization canary". Also add a threshold in Optimize that flags >4pt ROUGE regression for int quant jobs.

anya: PR created with loader permute + tokenmap smoke + unit tests. Assigning to @mike for review.

mike: reviewing now, will tidy tests and merge after CI green. Nice triage work. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks all, closing once CI passes.
